PostToolUse.description: Auto-format with Prettier after every file edit
TypeScript check after every file edit — catches type errors immediately
Security: Check if new/modified API routes have requireRole
PostToolUse.command: if echo "$TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" | grep -q 'app/api.*route.ts'; then if ! grep -q 'requireRole\|requirePermission' "$TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; then echo 'SECURITY WARNING: API route missing requireRole() or requirePermission()' >&2; exit 2; fi; fi
PostToolUse.windows: powershell -Command "if ($env:TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH -match 'app[/\\]api.*route\.ts') { if (-not (Select-String -Path $env:TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH -Pattern 'requireRole|requirePermission' -Quiet)) { Write-Error 'SECURITY WARNING: API route missing requireRole() or requirePermission()'; exit 2 } }"

PreToolUse.command: if echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE '(rbac\.ts|auth\.ts|middleware\.ts|encryption\.ts)' && echo "$TOOL_NAME" | grep -qi 'delete'; then echo 'BLOCKED: Cannot delete critical security files' >&2; exit 2; fi
PreToolUse.windows: powershell -Command "if (($env:TOOL_INPUT -match '(rbac|auth|middleware|encryption)\.ts') -and ($env:TOOL_NAME -match 'delete')) { Write-Error 'BLOCKED: Cannot delete critical security files'; exit 2 }"

AgentStop.description: Final review: run tsc + security scan when agent finishes a task
AgentStop.command: echo '=== FINAL REVIEW ===' && echo '--- TypeScript Check ---' && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -5 && echo '--- Unprotected Routes ---' && for f in $(find src/app/api -name 'route.ts' 2>/dev/null); do if ! grep -q 'requireRole\|requirePermission' "$f"; then echo "UNPROTECTED: $f"; fi; done && echo '--- console.log Count ---' && grep -rn 'console\.log' src/ --include='*.ts' --include='*.tsx' 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | wc -l && echo '=== REVIEW COMPLETE ==='
AgentStop.windows: cmd /c echo === FINAL REVIEW === && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 && echo === REVIEW COMPLETE ===
